01 / THE FEELING

Less perfect poses.
More presence.

Your practice does not have to look like anyone else’s. Yoga at Lotus is an invitation to listen, explore, and find ease in the space between movement and stillness.

02 / THE PRACTICE

Follow your
own rhythm.

Some days ask for movement. Others ask for quiet. There is space for both on the mat.

THREE WAYS TO FEEL GOOD
01
MOVEMENT / BREATH
01

Connect one movement to the next. Let your breath guide a fluid practice at a pace that feels right.

The intention

03 / YOUR RITUAL

From arrival
to exhale.

01

Find your ground

Settle on your mat. Notice how you feel without needing to change anything.

02

Follow your breath

Let your breath be a companion to movement. Ease into your own pace.

03

Make space for stillness

Close with a quiet moment. There is nothing else you need to do.

BEFORE YOU BEGIN

Before
you begin.

Do I need to be flexible?+

No. Yoga is a practice to explore, not a shape to achieve. Move within a range that feels comfortable for you.

What should I wear?+

Choose comfortable clothes that allow you to move freely. Equipment and mat availability will be confirmed with the studio opening details.

When can I join?+

Our studio programme is in development. Timetables and booking information will be announced on About & Contact.
